name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
description: Spa-Francorchamps in the Belgian Ardennes, the longest lap here. Eau Rouge and Raidillon climb the hill to the Kemmel straight, and it can rain at one end and not the other.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (2555 of 2802 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
